reasons: Both propose the same extract-then-generate pipeline with the SMS built only from quoted promises, plus code-level quote validation, and both justify the split by latency not mattering without discussing added cost. B handles invalid JSON more completely (it checks finish_reason for truncation, adds pydantic validation with a retry, and warns that strict mode does not prevent length cutoffs), and it critiques the reorder idea more sharply by noting that ticket_text and sms would come before the category and anchor it. A is otherwise equally strong, with a fuller strict schema, so the margin is small.
